name: Reportaj ADS Publisher
author: Reportaj Ads

sections.description:
The Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin is a robust tool designed to work seamlessly with the Reportaj Ads platform, a third-party service that empowers you to create, manage, and publish various types of content on your website. This plugin allows you to easily prepare and publish guest posts, review posts, suggested posts, and advertorial content.

About Reportaj Ads

Reportaj Ads is the third-party platform that the Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin relies on. It offers a user-friendly interface for content creation and provides strong tools for developing and managing diverse content types.

Data Transmission and Legal Considerations

When you use the Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin, data might be transferred between your website and the Reportaj Ads platform. This includes information related to content creation, user interactions, and other relevant data points. Please be aware of the following:

  • Link to Reportaj Ads: Reportaj Ads Platform
  • Reportaj Ads Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: Terms of Use

Legal Compliance

To ensure you comply with legal requirements regarding data transmissions, please review and follow the terms and conditions outlined in Reportaj Ads’ Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. By using the Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin, you acknowledge and accept any legal responsibilities associated with data transmissions between your website and the Reportaj Ads platform.

Getting Started

To integrate the Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin with your website and utilize the capabilities of the Reportaj Ads platform, follow these steps:

  • Install the Reportaj Ads Publisher Plugin
  • Configure API Settings
  • Create and Publish Content: Explore the powerful features of Reportaj Ads through the Reportaj Ads Publisher plugin to create and publish engaging guest posts, reviews, suggested posts, and advertorial content.

For more information about Reportaj Ads’ policies, refer to their official documentation or contact their support team with specific questions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins/reportajads-publisher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Reportaj ADS Publisher screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Follow any additional instructions provided to successfully integrate the plugin with your Reportaj ADS account.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

After installing the plugin, you need to configure the connection to the Reportaj ADS panel by entering the Web Service Code and Site Code. These settings can be found under the “Reportaj ADS Settings” submenu, which is visible in the WordPress settings. Ensure that these codes are correctly set up to enable the plugin to function properly and fetch reportage ads from your account.

How do I get a Reportaj ADS account?

To use this plugin, you need to create an account at Reportaj ADS. Visit their website and follow the registration process.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • New UI
  • Renamed the API key field label to Web Service Key.
  • Linked the existing API key description directly to the Reportaj ADS account page.
  • Added a direct account link for copying the Reportaj ADS web service key.
  • Replaced the web service account text link with an accessible API-key tooltip.
  • Redesigned the settings screen with a polished responsive interface.
  • Added the Reportaj ADS logo and connection status panel.
  • Added a direct settings link to the plugin action row.
  • Moved Reportaj ADS settings to a dedicated top-level dashboard menu.
  • Hardened REST credential comparisons while preserving the existing API contract.
  • Added the required REST permission callbacks without changing endpoint access parameters.
  • Improved missing credential validation and rejected non-scalar credential values.
  • Prevented API callbacks during autosaves and revisions.
  • Moved remote request errors to the standard server log without logging credentials.
  • Added the official WordPress.org plugin page link to the plugin metadata.
  • Removed inline styles, CSS classes, IDs, style blocks, scripts, and HTML comments from imported article content.
  • Preserved clean semantic HTML including headings, links, lists, tables, quotations, and images.
  • Removed the first successfully imported image from post content after assigning it as the featured image.
  • Fixed importing remote content images into the WordPress media library.
  • Fixed featured image assignment for both REST and scheduled imports.
  • Improved support for image URLs with query strings and single-quoted HTML attributes.

1.0.5

  • Bugs fixes and improvements

1.0.4

  • Bugs fixes and improvements
